name: group-page
title: Group page
description: A page for a club, choir, congregation, team or volunteer group: your mission in a bold band, when you meet and what's coming up, news, what you do and who leads it, then where to find you.

images.purpose: beside the mission in the coloured band: members together, doing what the group does; without it the mission runs alone across the band
images.alt_hint: who is in it and what they're doing, e.g. The choir singing at the spring concert
images.prompt: a real photograph of {subject}'s members together, mid-activity; wide, sharp, faces visible; never generated

images.purpose: the group's logo: in the header (44 px), above the mission, and the browser tab; must read at 32 px
images.prompt: the existing logo of {subject}; if there is none, a simple flat mark in the palette's accent colour

images.purpose: the picture when a link to the page is shared; empty uses the hero
a square photo on a card, round on the page: leaders and officers in the People group, or a program
images.alt_hint: the person's name and what they're doing, e.g. Maria Ortega conducting
images.prompt: a real photo the person chose of themselves

images.purpose: a photo at the top of a news story
images.prompt: a real photograph from the story

content.purpose: the mission in one line, the big headline in the coloured band
a sentence or two under the mission: who can come and what it costs
the main button in the band (with cta_link), e.g. Join us or Come to a rehearsal; cta2_label and cta2_link make a second, e.g. Donate (link out to the group's own donation page)

regular meeting times as weekly rows (e.g. tue 19:00-21:00); only the days you meet are shown, beside the upcoming events; exceptions show skipped weeks; note is one line under them. Shown in the events stream's section

one stream (layout list, e.g. title When we meet) whose entries are events: meeting times and upcoming events sit together under its title, past events fold under Earlier. One stream with layout feature for news: the newest in full beside a list of the rest
cards in groups, each group its own section: e.g. Programs (with period for when, price for dues) and People (subtitle is the role; a round photo if image is set)
about, history or what you believe, under about_title
where to find you: the address with a directions button, phone, email, social links
the banner across the top for cancellations and weather; set until so it goes by itself
big link tiles at the end: donate, volunteer, sign-up pages elsewhere (we never take payments)
the footer line; contact_line is a second, e.g. a charity number

art.ask: Ask for one wide photo of members together, doing what the group does. Get permission from the people shown; avoid photos of children unless a leader approves.
art.style: Photographs of real members; a logo, if any, is flat. Use real photos for real things; never make up pictures of real places, people or food. Illustrated art only for a mark or emblem, in the palette's accent colour.
steps: Use real photos for real things; never make up pictures of real places, people or food. Illustrated art only for a mark or emblem, in the palette's accent colour.
Get the hero photo (photo_upload_link works from a phone). Check it is wide (at least 2080 px across), sharp, faces visible, and note that the people shown agreed.
Write its alt text with your person, then upload it to site.hero with site.hero_alt.
For People cards, ask each person for their own photo and their OK; upload it to that card's image with image_alt.
If the group has a logo, upload it to site.logo; check it reads at 32 px.
Call theme_needs: every slot you meant to fill should say filled.
